outOfScope: Implementing BB-065 fixture/baseline, BB-067 sandbox enforcement, BB-068 SCM/CI delivery, BB-069 deployed product proof or the BB-074 comparative pilot.
Creating a second workflow/attempt authority with Restate, Temporal or LangGraph; the delivered DomainExecutionController remains attempt and recovery authority.
Production repository materialization or source publication before the Oracle phase is delivered; this adapter receives an already prepared bounded workspace.
Letting agent completion, OpenHands conversation status or the live probe accept delivery.
constraints: Reuse OpenHands Software Agent SDK version 1.49.4 at commit 3f47426e6af4681aacab735c781426aae58a3bac under MIT and require Python 3.12; install the SDK and tools from that same immutable monorepo commit through a generated uv lock.
Bind one OpenHands conversation ID and persistence directory deterministically to the existing runtimeInvocationKey; dispatch may create it once and recover may only reopen that identity.
BB-065 is READY but not delivered: worker execution remains blocked until BB-065 is DONE and consumes its implemented fixture/profile rather than restating the dependency plan.
The live provider/model/profile and credentials are operator inputs; credentials never enter manifests, logs, artifacts or git.
Real-provider evidence is separate from deterministic adapter tests. Missing credentials, incomplete SDK usage, an unresolved interruption or failed independent fixture acceptance fails closed.
invariants: Application owns work semantics and domain authority; Oracle owns source IO; runtime success is not acceptance or publication authority.
Every result binds exact source, attempt, configuration and evidence; unknown effects or missing evidence cannot be called success.
The outer Blackboard schedules ExHarness development only; product runtime coordination remains a separate system.
architectureDecisions: Select a thin Node runtimeAdapter over a Python OpenHands SDK driver. DomainExecutionController continues to create and pin the semantic execution attempt; the adapter maps its runtimeInvocationKey to exactly one durable OpenHands conversation.

Extend the delivered execution-strategy enum with coding-agent-sdk and extend controller.execute with an optional AbortSignal passed out-of-band to dispatch/recover. The signal is process control only: it is not cloned into semantic input, binding or evidence identity.

Use strategy descriptor {strategyId: openhands-sdk-local-v1, strategyVersion: 1.49.4+3f47426, strategyKind: coding-agent-sdk, runtimeBindingMode: EXACT_PERSISTED_CONVERSATION}; adapterRef and expectedRuntimeCodeRef must equal the constructed runtime adapter identities.

Pin OpenHands software-agent-sdk 1.49.4 and openhands-tools from monorepo commit 3f47426e6af4681aacab735c781426aae58a3bac. Its LocalConversation create-or-resume path persists base state and events, supports a fixed conversation_id, and can resume with agent=None in a fresh process.

Use the BB-065 request-tracker workspace prepared by the caller. The adapter accepts a canonical workspace root, immutable starting tree/hash, task ID, prompt ref/hash and output directory; it does not clone repositories, select work, or publish source.

Construct the adapter with explicit modelProfileResolver and workspaceResolver ports. dispatch resolves binding.modelProfileRef and the input workspace descriptor, hashes both canonical documents, and records them before Python starts; recover resolves them again and requires exact equality with the immutable manifest.

Store an immutable attempt manifest before launching Python under <output>/attempts/<sha256(runtimeInvocationKey)>/manifest.json. It pins executionAttemptId, runtimeInvocationKey hash, workspace root and starting tree, strategy/toolset/model/harness refs, SDK commit/version, profile hash, conversation UUID and persistence directory.

Dispatch uses exclusive manifest creation. If a manifest already exists, it records collision evidence and throws OpenHandsRecoveryRequiredError without spawning Python or calling a provider; controller recovery must reconcile the existing attempt. Recover validates the exact manifest and workspace identity, then reopens the same conversation ID/persistence directory; mismatch returns BLOCKED and never creates another conversation.

At pinned OpenHands commit 3f47426e6af4681aacab735c781426aae58a3bac, Agent accepts TerminalTool and FileEditorTool; FileEditorTool constructs FileEditorExecutor with workspace_root=conv_state.workspace.working_dir; standalone SDK examples create Conversation(agent=agent, workspace=...), send_message and run. This is the concrete execution/editing seam used by the adapter, not an inferred capability.

Dispatch sends the task prompt exactly once after creating the conversation. Recover constructs LocalConversation(agent=None, same conversation_id, same persistence_dir, same workspace) and never resends the prompt; a complete atomically published driver result is replayed without calling conversation.run again.

OpenHands owns conversation events and tool execution state inside the adapter. ExHarness owns attempt lifecycle, policy pins, runtime attestation, completion evaluation and publication authority. OpenHands completion maps only to a runtime result candidate.

Timeout or AbortSignal cancellation sends SIGTERM to the driver, waits a bounded grace period, then SIGKILL if required and throws OpenHandsRecoveryRequiredError after durable process evidence. DomainExecutionController therefore commits RECOVERY_REQUIRED. A later recover may return UNKNOWN only after it has conclusively failed to reconcile the prior effect. Process exit, signal, stdout/stderr digests and recovery decision are captured without secrets.

Use only TerminalTool and FileEditorTool in the selected profile. The driver rejects additional tool names, workspace escape, mutable branch/ref dependencies, and a model/profile different from the immutable manifest.

Reject Restate at eda4cf97ec8794614329d97078a3c8c3a8701c4f because a new BSL server duplicates delivered attempt recovery authority; reject Temporal server at 543367eec690da3c23e536cf5dfe76928af11b2c and LangGraph at 1211af45b18cab9c0a7efe366ba12f51ad2a9996 because their workflow/checkpoint authorities add a second lifecycle for this single domain-local adapter.

Reject mini-SWE-agent at 04d809ceab9df28f9adaed044884180159172930 as the integrated strategy: it is the direct baseline selected by BB-065 and intentionally runs independent subprocess actions, while its documented saved history is not a durable fresh-process conversation resume contract. Reject SWE-agent at 3ea751c087f32b16e039a2233dd6eefecef325d5 because trajectory replay is inspection/re-execution rather than continuation of the same live attempt.

Preserve immutable ExecutionAttemptBinding/runtimeInvocationKey, one manifest/session per invocation, content-addressed evidence, completion/publication authority separation and RECOVERY_REQUIRED on ambiguous dispatch. Exit: unit-adapter + domain-regression cover collision, drift, cancellation, authority bypass, result schema/evidence digests and no-second-session.

S2 — Pinned OpenHands driver [REAL_DISPATCH, SAME_SESSION_RECOVERY, FAIL_CLOSED_RECOVERY, SUPPLY_CHAIN; invariant 2]: add pyproject.toml, uv.lock and openhands_driver.py pinned to SDK/tools 1.49.4 at commit 3f47426e6af4681aacab735c781426aae58a3bac. Construct only TerminalTool/FileEditorTool, bind workspace/persistence/conversation IDs from the immutable manifest, send NORM-01 once on dispatch and use agent=None on recover. S3 — Real fixture dispatch/recovery [REAL_DISPATCH, SAME_SESSION_RECOVERY, FAIL_CLOSED_RECOVERY, BOUNDED_TERMINATION; invariant 2]: require BB-065 DONE and exact request-tracker-baseline-v1; dispatch NORM-01 through production DomainExecutionController, interrupt only after durable OpenHands activity, assert RECOVERY_REQUIRED, restart Node/Python, recover the exact same conversation, and independently verify copied candidate source with protected BB-065 acceptance. Exit: live-probe binds task/prompt/profile/tool/SDK/session/tree/change/process/evidence identities and treats missing live prerequisites as non-pass.

S4 — Evidence + consolidation [REAL_DISPATCH, AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY, SUPPLY_CHAIN; invariants 1–3]: bind exact candidate/tree, runtime attestations, output/effect/trace/counterevidence refs, lock audit, unit/domain tests, live probe and protected acceptance into worker evidence; update Living state with supported strategy and limitations. Exit: Living Docs changed, every criterion maps to declared verification, OpenHands success remains only a runtime candidate and worker Jev receives exact candidate-bound evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: After BB-065 is DONE and matches dependencyFixtureContract, a credential-bearing live probe routes one released DomainExecutionController claim through runtimeAdapter.dispatch into OpenHands SDK 1.49.4 at the pinned commit, edits only the declared NORM-01 fixture source, and produces bounded runtime/source evidence plus independent protected BB-065 acceptance evidence.
evidenceRequired: Exact candidate/tree, work and executionAttempt IDs, runtimeInvocationKey hash, SDK commit/version, model/profile/toolset hashes, NORM-01 task/prompt hash, starting and resulting workspace tree hashes, sorted changed paths, process result, redacted stdout/stderr digests and independent fixture acceptance report.
Exact controller outcome fields: runtimeInvocationId, timestamps, content-addressed output/effect/trace/verification refs and derivation edges accepted by the delivered controller contract.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: During recover, missing/corrupt persistence, starting-tree drift, profile/tool/strategy mismatch or an unreconcilable killed process returns BLOCKED or UNKNOWN without any fresh dispatch or second provider session.

evidenceRequired: TERM/KILL trace, exit/signal data and bounded elapsed time.
Canonical attempt-head assertion proving ambiguous dispatch/cancellation becomes RECOVERY_REQUIRED, plus a recover-only UNKNOWN assertion when exact prior effects cannot be reconciled.

negativeVerificationCases: A second dispatch for an existing runtimeInvocationKey must not spawn Python or call a provider.
Recover with missing/corrupt OpenHands base state or a different conversation ID must fail closed.
Workspace starting tree, SDK commit, model profile, toolset, harness or strategy drift must not resume.

SIGTERM timeout or cancellation after possible activity with no conclusive driver result must throw OpenHandsRecoveryRequiredError and leave the canonical attempt RECOVERY_REQUIRED; only a later recover may return UNKNOWN after reconciliation fails.
A driver payload containing acceptance, publication or Blackboard mutation fields must be rejected.
Secrets present in environment or provider exceptions must not appear in manifest, stdout/stderr evidence or result JSON.
Agent-declared success with failing BB-065 independent acceptance must remain a rejected completion candidate.
Returning UNKNOWN from initial dispatch must fail the adapter contract test; ambiguous dispatch must throw and leave the canonical attempt RECOVERY_REQUIRED.
AbortSignal must be forwarded outside the structured-cloned semantic input; aborted execution must preserve the original binding and invocation identity.
A strategy kind other than the exact coding-agent-sdk descriptor or a mismatched adapter/runtime code ref must be rejected before driver spawn.

driverProtocol.output: stdout contains exactly one bounded JSON envelope; diagnostic output goes to bounded stderr. The Node adapter rejects extra bytes, invalid schema, identity mismatch or unbounded output.
driverProtocol.atomicity: Driver writes result.tmp, fsyncs file and parent, then renames to result.json. Existing valid result is immutable and replayable.

driverEnvelope.evidenceRefs: relative refs inside attempt output only

mapping.SUCCEEDED: exit 0 + FINISHED + complete identity/evidence + all changed paths allowed; still only a completion candidate
mapping.FAILED: conclusive agent/tool failure with no ambiguous in-flight effect
mapping.UNKNOWN: Only adapter.recover may return UNKNOWN after examining the exact persisted conversation/effects and concluding they cannot be reconciled; completionEvaluator must map it to INCONCLUSIVE.
mapping.RECOVERY_REQUIRED_EXCEPTION: If dispatch/recover ends after possible activity without an atomic complete result, persist process/counterevidence then throw OpenHandsRecoveryRequiredError. Controller catch moves ACTIVE to RECOVERY_REQUIRED and rethrows.
mapping.BLOCKED: Conclusive preflight identity/config/workspace/persistence violation before provider/tool execution, or recover proves continuation is impossible without ambiguity.
